entities.name: Et3SiH
observations: Matching ORD record reports triethylsilane with trifluoroacetic acid for converting an aryl acetyl group to an ethyl group.

entities.name: Trifluoroacetic acid
observations: Matching ORD record reports TFA with triethylsilane for ketone-to-methylene reduction in the specified substrate.

entities.name: Sodium bicarbonate
observations: Matching ORD record includes sodium bicarbonate; its precise role is unspecified and it may be used for neutralization or workup.

entities.name: Aryl ketone deoxygenation
observations: The transformation changes Ar–C(=O)CH3 to Ar–CH2CH3 while retaining the ester and allyl ether groups.
